# ML artifact

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-docs.mjs. Edit the manifest, then run `make docs`. -->

Upload or download model/dataset artifacts to S3, GCS, or the Hugging Face Hub

```yaml
- uses: patrickisgreat/actions-toolkit/actions/ml-artifact@v1
  with:
    operation: # upload \| download
    local-path: # Local file or directory.
    remote-uri: # Remote location: `s3://…`, `gs://…`, or `hf://owner/repo[@revision]`.
```

## How it works

Move model weights, datasets, and eval artifacts between the runner and durable storage.

Model artifacts are too big for the GitHub Actions artifact store and too important to
live only in a training job's scratch space. This action gives training and eval
pipelines one interface over the three places these things actually live, chosen by the
URI scheme:

  s3://bucket/prefix        → S3           (authenticate with `aws-auth` first)
  gs://bucket/prefix        → GCS          (authenticate with `gcp-auth` first)
  hf://owner/repo[@rev]     → Hugging Face Hub (needs `hf-token` for private/write)

`manifest: true` writes a `manifest.json` next to the upload recording every file's size
and SHA-256 plus the commit that produced it. That is what makes a model artifact
traceable back to the code and data that built it — without it, "which commit produced
the weights currently in prod?" has no answer.

Downloads verify against the manifest when one is present, so a truncated or corrupted
transfer fails the job instead of silently training on half a dataset.

## Inputs

| Input | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `operation` | **yes** | — | upload \| download |
| `local-path` | **yes** | — | Local file or directory. |
| `remote-uri` | **yes** | — | Remote location: `s3://…`, `gs://…`, or `hf://owner/repo[@revision]`. |
| `hf-token` | no | `""` | Hugging Face token. Required for private repos and any upload. |
| `hf-repo-type` | no | `model` | model \| dataset \| space |
| `include` | no | `""` | Space-separated glob patterns to include. Empty means everything. |
| `exclude` | no | `""` | Space-separated glob patterns to exclude. |
| `manifest` | no | `true` | true to write/verify a `manifest.json` with per-file SHA-256 checksums. |
| `commit-message` | no | `""` | Commit message for a Hugging Face upload. |
| `storage-class` | no | `""` | S3 storage class, e.g. `STANDARD_IA` or `INTELLIGENT_TIERING`. |
| `fail-if-missing` | no | `true` | false to make a download of a non-existent remote a no-op instead of an error. |

## Outputs

| Output | Description |
|---|---|
| `uri` | The remote URI that was written to or read from. |
| `files` | Number of files transferred. |
| `bytes` | Total bytes transferred. |
| `manifest-file` | Path to the manifest, when one was written or found. |
| `exists` | `false` when a download found nothing and `fail-if-missing` was false. |
